title: PolicyCommitment
description: A quantitative policy commitment extracted from Malaysian government tourism documents.

source_doc.description: PDF filename from which the commitment was extracted.

source_page.description: 1-indexed page number where the commitment appears.

state.description: Canonical 3-letter state code (e.g. JOH, SGR) or 'national' for federal-level commitments.

target_value.description: The quantitative target specified in the commitment.

target_year.description: Year by which the target is to be achieved.

baseline_value.description: Baseline or reference value, if stated. Null if not available.

baseline_year.description: Year of the baseline value, if stated. Null if not available.

sustainability_dimension.description: Which sustainability pillar the commitment aligns to.

verbatim_quote.description: Exact quote from the source document supporting this commitment.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence: high = explicit target with year, medium = numeric but context unclear, low = ambiguous quote.
